title: Small, It's not a couch a futon.
text: Small, It's not a couch a futon.. I'm actually really sadden about this couch because I thought it was much bigger, taller and more wider than expected. I spent $800 on this couch and it's literally a small couch that doesn't even fell my living room. it looks more like a futon then a couch. So if you have a really small living room this will be perfect for it. I wish I could get my money back for this because even the pillows for your back is short.don't waste your money only if you want a small couch. Well a futon.
